title: Homogeneous cocycles and inhomogeneous two-cocycles
statement: For every field K, the continuous homogeneous degree-two cocycle space for galoisUnitsTopRep K is equivalent to the explicitly defined continuous inhomogeneous two-cocycle space.

proof.text: Define the forward map by evaluating at (1,g,gh) and the inverse by the equivariant formula. Continuity follows from the Krull topology and the discrete coefficient action; the cocycle equation follows by the homogeneous differential calculation.
